prompts.question: New question
prompts.value: Enter a value for {item}. Say cancel task to leave.
prompts.confirmControl: Review: {item}. Say yes to request it, or no to cancel.
prompts.requested: Requested {item}. Check the page for the actual result.
prompts.unavailable: This control needs browser or device assistance, or is unavailable. {item}
prompts.stale: The page or options changed. Ask for page options again.
prompts.secure: Use secure device input for passwords and codes. These are not entered or read through chat.
prompts.cancelled: Task cancelled. An already submitted action may still finish. What would you like next?
prompts.readConsent: Read the current page aloud? Say yes or no. Private information may be audible.
prompts.dictation: Field entry mode: answers only edit this field. Use new question or cancel task to leave.
prompts.welcome: Hello. I am your health guide. You can talk to me or tap a picture.
prompts.askTask: Would you like to book a doctor, check symptoms, or find a hospital?
prompts.yesNo: Please say yes or no, or tap the matching button.
prompts.help: Say book a doctor, check symptoms, find a hospital, or repeat.
prompts.micDenied: Allow microphone access to speak. You can still tap the pictures.
prompts.micUnavailable: Voice input is unavailable here. Use the pictures or type.
prompts.voiceUnavailable: This device has no voice for your language. You can use the pictures or the local voice service.
prompts.keepScreenOn: Voice assistance works while this page stays open and active.
prompts.offlineReady: Saved guidance is available offline. A booking needs an online confirmation.
prompts.downloadOffline: Prepare this language for offline use.
prompts.loginRequired: Please sign in before managing your appointments or records.
prompts.onlineRequired: Please connect to the internet to confirm this action.
prompts.error: I could not complete that. Please try again or ask a health worker for help.
prompts.stopVoice: Voice paused. Tap me when you need help.
prompts.askAge: How old is the patient? Say the age in years.
prompts.askSymptoms: Tell me the symptoms, one at a time.
prompts.askDuration: For how many days have these symptoms been present?
prompts.askTemperature: If you measured the temperature, tell me the value and whether it is Celsius or Fahrenheit. Otherwise skip.
prompts.askIntensity: Are the symptoms mild, moderate, or severe?
prompts.askDoctor: Choose a doctor. Say the number next to their picture.
prompts.askDate: Which date? Say today, tomorrow, or a date like 24 November.
prompts.askSlot: Choose an available time. Say the option number.
prompts.askMode: Would you like video, audio, or chat?
prompts.confirmBooking: Book {doctor} on {date} at {time}? Say yes to confirm or no to go back.
prompts.bookingSuccess: Your appointment is confirmed for {date} at {time}.
prompts.bookingQueued: Your request is saved on this device. It is not confirmed yet. We will send it when you reconnect.
prompts.bookingFailed: Your appointment was not booked. Please choose another time or try again.
prompts.dateInvalid: I did not understand the date. Choose today, tomorrow, or use the calendar.
prompts.numberInvalid: I did not understand the number. Say it again or tap a choice.
prompts.queuedPending: This request is waiting for an online confirmation.
prompts.serverUnavailable: The service is unavailable. No appointment has been confirmed.
prompts.triageLow: No urgent warning was found in the information you gave. This is not a diagnosis. Contact a health worker if symptoms continue or worsen.
prompts.triageMedium: Please contact a health worker or your nearest primary health centre soon. This is not a diagnosis.
prompts.triageHigh: Please seek urgent medical care today. If breathing becomes difficult, you faint, or the condition worsens, call 108 immediately.
prompts.triageEmergency: This may be an emergency. Call 108 now or go to the nearest hospital emergency department. Do not wait for this assistant.
prompts.unknownSymptoms: I could not recognise those symptoms. Please choose a picture or ask a health worker. If the patient is seriously unwell, call 108.
prompts.confirmCancel: Cancel this appointment on {date} at {time}? Say yes or no.
prompts.askPhone: What phone number should the clinic use?
prompts.confirmReadRecords: Read your private medical records aloud? Continue only in a private place.
prompts.noProviders: No verified providers are available. Ask a local health worker.
prompts.offlineSlots: These are request times, not confirmed availability. Choose a time.
prompts.selectionInvalid: Say the option number, or tap it.
prompts.intakeComplete: Your symptom information is ready to check.
prompts.offlineGuidance: You can try the pages already saved on this device. An appointment is confirmed only after the service accepts it online.
prompts.offlineCallsNote: These buttons open the phone dialler. A call needs telephone service; tapping does not dispatch help.
prompts.offlineVoiceNote: Spoken guidance needs a matching device voice or an available local voice service. Saving this page alone does not install a voice.
prompts.offlineSymptomsNote: Use the built-in symptom questions. This is not a diagnosis.
prompts.offlineEmergencyNote: In a serious emergency, do not wait for the internet or this app.
